pages.name: Spanish: Archangelsk, 7.d3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-e3 with the rook on f1; plan 4 suggested ...Na7. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Archangelsk, 7.Re1 Bc5 8.c3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight; plan 4 suggested a ...d5 break with the d-pawn already on d6. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Moeller Defence, 6.c3
pages.notes: Overview called c5 the light-squared bishop's square; plan 3 rerouted a "b-pawn knight" with the rook on f1; plan 4 suggested an untypical ...d5. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Steinitz Deferred
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an ambiguous Nd2-f1-e3; plan 3 put a white knight on d5, which the c6-pawn covers. Overview now explains 7...Nxe4 8.Re1 and ...f5. Reviewer rejected "open e-file" (it is half-open); fixed and re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish Game, Closed Variations
pages.notes: Kecskemet-type 9...Be8: plan 1 had an unreadable Nbd2-f1-g3/e3; plan 3 had ...Nf8-g6 with no knight on f8 (a Breyer idea). Rewritten around ...Nd7 and ...Bf6, the point of the bishop retreat. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Steinitz Deferred, 6.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route with the pawn on b7 and ignored the pin on c6; plan 4 had ...exd4 with no d4-pawn. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Steinitz Deferred, 6.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 ignored the pin on the c6-knight. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Steinitz Deferred, Exchange
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f4-f5 advance blocked by the f3-knight; plan 2 advanced ...b5 (no b-pawn after ...bxc6) and ...c5 before the recapture. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez, Riga Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 described pins on an f6-knight that is not there and suggested Nxd5 or Bxd5 (impossible). Rewritten: Black is two pawns up; White has the e-file and the Bg5 pin on e7. No source found for 8.Bg5 Be7 theory; plans judged on the board. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Bernstein Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 manoeuvred a "b2-knight" via Nf1-g3 and put the dark-squared bishop on the light squares. Rewritten around Nd2, c3 and 9...Nc5 10.c3 d4. Reviewer queried a game citation; removed and re-accepted. British spelling.
